points.point: HeyGen avatar videos don't show up in Blotato (how HeyGen works with Blotato)
points.sentence: Make your avatar video in the Heygen web app, download the completed video, and attach it to your post in blotato

verdict.reason: The entry explains that HeyGen videos don't sync into Blotato on their own. You download them and attach them to a post, or you automate it through make.com and the API.
